findings.claim: The copy constructor MessagePackSecurity(MessagePackSecurity copyFrom) no longer copies HashCollisionResistant. Anything built from a copy, such as WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth or other derived instances, silently loses hash-collision resistance. A copy of MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData would then use non-resistant comparers for Dictionary/HashSet keys, which re-opens the hash-flooding DoS that UntrustedData is meant to prevent. The change is unrelated to the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage requirement.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a unit test: var s = MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth(10); Assert.True(s.HashCollisionResistant). Also deserialize a Dictionary<string,..> with s and assert the comparer is collision-resistant. It passes on base and fails on head. A mutation that restores the deleted line would be killed by this test.
